## About
Pro Image Auto Repair sits in Arvada, close to Wadsworth, and just minutes from Golden, Wheatridge, Lakewood and Westminster. Whether you need an oil change, a whole engine replaced, or you have an electrical problem that is driving you crazy, bring it in.
Your car is checked with the latest diagnostics equipment, and everything we do to it is explained to you in layman’s terms. Our goal is simple: the best service at the best rates, without wasting your time.
Customers know the shop by Tee, who reviewers call honest, fair and friendly. We hold a 5 star Google rating from 31 reviews, and a lot of those folks have been bringing their family cars to us for years.

## Services
- Electronic Fuel Injection Service and Repairs: Service and repair for your fuel injection system.
- Anti-lock Brake System Service and Repairs: ABS service and repair to keep your brakes working the way they should.
- Power Window and Door Lock Repair: Windows that stick and locks that quit, fixed.
- Transmission Service and Repairs: Transmission service and repair work.
- Engine Service and Repairs: From routine engine service to an entire engine replaced.
- Brake Service and Repairs: Brake service and repair work.
- Electrical Diagnosis and Repair: For the electrical problem that is driving you crazy.
- Registered State Emission Repair Facility: We are a registered state emission repair facility.

## FAQ
Q: What makes do you work on?
A: We specialize in Hondas and Acuras, and we also work on Toyota, Lexus, Nissan, Infiniti, Subaru and Mitsubishi.

Q: Can I get a loaner car while mine is in the shop?
A: We may be able to provide you with a loaner car for the day. Please call ahead to double check.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We provide a satisfaction guarantee for all services. Give us a call for the guarantee details.

Q: When is the garage open?
A: The garage is open Monday through Friday. We are closed on weekends.
